Attribute.Name: Accepted Products
Attribute.ValueTemplate:
<derive expr="{x:={
    childProductClass:=filter(
        children(),
        'exact(StepObjectTypeID(),"SupplierProductsClassification")'
    )
}
iterate(
    filter(
        iterate(childProductClass, 'subproducts()'),
        '{updateStatus:=valuelovid("PMDM.AT.UpdateApprovalBuyerStatus")}if(exact(updateStatus, ""), exact(valuelovid("PMDM.AT.ProposalApprovalBuyerStatus"),"AP"), exact(updateStatus,"AP"))'
    ),
    'concatenate(stepid(), \"\n\")'
)}listlen(x)"/>
